name: Jesus
summary: The Son of God whose authoritative teaching, exorcisms, and healings in Galilee give way to rejection, suffering, death, and resurrection in Jerusalem, a path Mark structures around the question of who he really is.

name: John the Baptist
summary: A wilderness preacher who baptizes Jesus in the Jordan, is later imprisoned by Herod Antipas for condemning his marriage to Herodias, and is beheaded at a birthday banquet.

name: Peter
summary: A fisherman renamed Peter by Jesus who becomes a leading disciple, confesses Jesus as the Christ, witnesses the Transfiguration, and denies knowing Jesus three times the night of his arrest.

name: Andrew
summary: A fisherman and Peter's brother, called together with him to leave their nets and follow Jesus.

name: James son of Zebedee
summary: A fisherman called with his brother John, one of the inner three who witness the Transfiguration, who together with John asks Jesus for the seats of honor in his glory.

name: John son of Zebedee
summary: A fisherman called with his brother James and given the name Boanerges, Sons of Thunder, one of the inner three who witness the Transfiguration and reports stopping a man who cast out demons in Jesus's name.

name: Levi
summary: A tax collector Jesus calls away from his tax booth to follow him, who then hosts a meal where Jesus eats with tax collectors and sinners.

name: The Gerasene Demoniac
summary: A man living among the tombs of the Gerasenes, possessed by so many unclean spirits that he calls himself Legion, whom Jesus frees by sending the spirits into a herd of pigs.

name: The Woman with the Flow of Blood
summary: A woman who has suffered a discharge of blood for twelve years and spent all she had on physicians, healed instantly when she touches Jesus's garment in a crowd.

name: Jairus
summary: A ruler of the synagogue whose twelve-year-old daughter Jesus raises from death after she is reported dead.

name: Herod Antipas
summary: The tetrarch who imprisons John the Baptist for condemning his marriage to Herodias and has him beheaded after a rash oath to her dancing daughter, though he had feared John as a righteous man.

name: Herodias
summary: Herod Antipas's wife, whose marriage John the Baptist publicly condemns, and who presses her daughter to demand John's execution.

name: Herodias's Daughter
summary: Herod Antipas's stepdaughter, unnamed in Mark, whose dancing pleases Herod at his birthday banquet and who, prompted by her mother, asks for John the Baptist's head on a platter.

name: The Disciples
summary: Jesus's followers, including the Twelve, who marvel at his authority over the storm and are warned to beware the leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod.

name: The Syrophoenician Woman
summary: A Gentile woman from the region of Tyre who persists in asking Jesus to free her daughter from a demon even after he first refuses, and whose answer about the dogs under the table wins her request.

name: Bartimaeus
summary: A blind beggar at Jericho, the son of Timaeus, who cries out to Jesus as the Son of David despite the crowd's rebukes and receives his sight for his faith.

name: The Crowd
summary: The crowd that spreads cloaks and branches on the road and shouts Hosanna as Jesus rides into Jerusalem.

name: Judas Iscariot
summary: One of the Twelve who goes to the chief priests to betray Jesus for money and identifies him to the arresting crowd with a kiss at Gethsemane.

name: The High Priest
summary: The unnamed presiding officer of the Sanhedrin who tears his robes and condemns Jesus for blasphemy after Jesus affirms he is the Christ, the Son of the Blessed.

name: Pontius Pilate
summary: The Roman governor who questions Jesus, offers to release him in place of Barabbas, and has him flogged and crucified when the crowd demands it.

name: Barabbas
summary: A prisoner jailed for murder during an insurrection whom the crowd chooses to have released instead of Jesus.

name: Simon of Cyrene
summary: A passerby, the father of Alexander and Rufus, whom the soldiers compel to carry Jesus's cross to Golgotha.

name: The Centurion
summary: The Roman officer standing watch at the cross who, seeing how Jesus dies, declares him the Son of God.

name: Joseph of Arimathea
summary: A respected member of the council looking for the kingdom of God, who asks Pilate for Jesus's body and lays it in a rock-cut tomb.

name: Mary Magdalene
summary: A woman out of whom Jesus had cast seven demons, who watches the crucifixion and burial, finds the tomb empty, and is the first to see the risen Jesus.

name: The Young Man at the Tomb
summary: A young man dressed in a white robe sitting in the empty tomb who tells the women Jesus has risen and is going ahead of them to Galilee.

name: The Boy's Father
summary: A desperate father whose son has been afflicted by a mute spirit since childhood, who cries out to Jesus, "I believe; help my unbelief!"
